title: SearchResponse
description: STUB — placeholder shape, to be finalized by Agnel (schema owner) with Yizhen (access/privacy policy). Returned by a hospital node's /api/beacon/query endpoint. Matches the example in architecture.md's 'Two Schema Layers > Search/metadata layer' section. A suppressed match must never carry a raw count.

query_id.description: Echoes the DiscoveryQuery.query_id this response answers.

node_id.description: Identifier of the responding hospital node.

exists.description: Whether any records matched, without revealing a count.

count.description: Exact count, or null when suppressed. STUB — policy owner Yizhen decides when this may be non-null (see architecture.md small-cohort threshold).

display_count.description: Human-readable count string safe to render, e.g. '<10' or '47'.

suppressed.description: True if count was withheld due to small-cohort policy.

available_data.description: STUB — data types available if access is later approved, e.g. ['deidentified-dicom'].

access_request_supported.description: Whether this node currently accepts access requests.
